observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: spacious dance studio with light wood flooring, white walls, large windows and a row of mirrors along one wall
observation.dancers: group of 9 women of mixed ages
observation.formation_and_space: a single horizontal line facing forward, moving in unison as a group without traveling across the room
observation.posture: upright torso, soft knees, weight shifting evenly from foot to foot on the beat
observation.footwork: side-shuffles, rock-steps, jazz boxes, and diagonal V-steps in synchronization with the music; exact heel-toe articulation is occluded by footwear and video quality
observation.arms_and_hands: arms hang naturally at sides during basic steps, rising to clap in front of the chest during specific rhythm sections
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso movement, natural hip sway accompanying weight changes and turns
observation.partnering: none, all dancers perform individually in formation
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing level throughout, quarter and half turns executed on the balls of the feet with no jumps or floor work
observation.costume_and_props: casual exercise attire of colored t-shirts or tops with dark trousers or leggings; no props
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot articulation and precise weight transfer cannot be determined due to distance and video resolution

signature_moments.what: dancers execute a jazz box while clapping hands in front of the chest
synchronized clap pattern performed while shifting weight on the spot
group clapping overhead and to the sides on the beat
